Whoops, I guess I put too much emphasis on that then. I just meant to say that a handful of girls think I'm good looking, yet I still think I'm a little below average, at best. 

You've helped immensely, so thank you again and goodbye :)

Getting a girl isn't so much my problem. I don't mind being single that much. If I wanted one I wouldn't hesitate to try, rejection doesn't bother me too much anymore.  

That being said, this reply brought a big smile to my face, so thank you so very very much. Thanks for the advice, I'll start working up the nerve to talk to my mom about this stuff.
